meaning: Source pages for review. Closed calls are watchlist/preparation references and must not be promoted as open.

pages.name: UNIBEN university
pages.eligibility: University announcements. Each scholarship needs its own official call.

pages.name: UNIBEN news
pages.eligibility: Campus notices. Recheck the organiser, cycle and deadline.

pages.name: University of Nigeria
pages.eligibility: University notices. Some calls are restricted to its own students.

pages.name: University of Lagos
pages.eligibility: University notices. Confirm eligibility at the organiser.

pages.name: University of Ibadan scholarships
pages.eligibility: Scholarship notices can include postgraduate calls. Filter degree and current cycle.

pages.name: University of Port Harcourt
pages.eligibility: Use the current home page. The old latest-info path did not load.

pages.name: FUNAAB
pages.eligibility: University notices. Do not assume a call applies to other campuses.

pages.name: Federal Ministry of Education
pages.eligibility: Identify the specific undergraduate award and official portal before recommending.

pages.name: PTDF in-country 2026/27
pages.eligibility: 200 level; public university; CGPA at least 2.4/5; listed oil, energy or management course. Pharmacy is not listed.

pages.name: MTN scholarship criteria
pages.eligibility: STS: entering/current 300 level STEM, or medical entering/current 400 level. Separate blind-student scheme. Portal says closed.

pages.name: MTN application portal
pages.eligibility: The submission form explicitly reports closure. Do not promote the Apply link as an open round.

pages.name: Shell Nigeria scholarships
pages.eligibility: The visible 2026 postgraduate call closed 8 June. Check a distinct undergraduate call before recommending.

pages.name: Seplat undergraduate 2026
pages.eligibility: Federal/state university; CGPA at least 3.5; five O-level credits including English and maths in one sitting; listed courses. Current window unconfirmed.

pages.name: Seplat linked application portal
pages.eligibility: Linked by the official Seplat announcement. Retrieval failed here. Confirm the live round directly.

pages.name: Scholastica scholarship directory
pages.eligibility: A directory is not a live award. Inspect each scheme's own eligibility and closure banner.

pages.name: NNPC/Chevron CNL 2026
pages.eligibility: 200 level admitted 2024/25; pharmacy included; CGPA at least 3.5/5; six O-level credits in one sitting. Separate blind-student route.

pages.name: Julius Berger female award 2026
pages.eligibility: Female engineering students; full-time public university; 200 level; CGPA at least 3.5/5. Confirm all listed courses.

pages.name: NEPL/OERNL tertiary award 2026/27
pages.eligibility: 100 level only. National merit course rules and host-community category differ. 200 level and above excluded.

pages.name: GOSEF 2026
pages.eligibility: Nigerian resident; public tertiary student; age 16–25; CGPA at least 4.5/5; financial need.

pages.name: Femi Bewaji undergraduate award
pages.eligibility: Continuing public-university student; age 15–24; CGPA at least 4.0/5; household income below NGN 3m; no duplicate funding of same costs.

pages.name: Nifemi Brown undergraduate award
pages.eligibility: Nigerian full-time undergraduate; financial need; good academic standing. Supports tuition and one training, with stated exclusions.

pages.name: NHEF expanded access 2026
pages.eligibility: Pre-penultimate/penultimate year at a Nigerian federal university; this expanded window excluded the named partner universities.

pages.name: Millennium Fellowship applications
pages.eligibility: 2026 closed. 2027 waitlist only; no confirmed 2027 application deadline. 2026 rules required age 18+, enrolled undergraduate and social impact.

pages.name: Delta state bursary extension
pages.eligibility: Delta state origin; full-time approved institution; university 200 level+; CGPA at least 2.20; NIN. Official 2026 fee NGN 800.

pages.name: TotalEnergies merit scholarship portal
pages.eligibility: Primary company subdomain. Search indexed a merit scheme; page retrieval failed. Deadline and eligible current course/level not confirmed.
